data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name 'Stephanos', meaning 'crown' or 'wreath'. In the New Testament, the name Stephani is borne by several early Christian martyrs, including St. Stephani of Rome, who was stoned to death for her faith. The name Stephani carries the meaning “Crown of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Stephani usually hope their child will grow to embody crown of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name Stephani carries a rich cultural heritage with its root in ancient Greece. It was a popular name among early Christians, especially martyrs, who wore a crown or wreath as a symbol of honor and martyrdom. Today, the name Stephani is cherished by many Christian families as a reminder of the courage and faith demonstrated by the early Christian martyrs.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Stephani lies in its association with the concept of crowning or honoring. In Christian tradition, the name is a reminder of the crown of martyrdom that Stephani and other early Christian martyrs wore as a symbol of their faith and dedication to God. It serves as a constant reminder to those bearing the name to live a life of faith, courage, and devotion to God, striving for the ultimate reward of eternal life in the crown of glory.
